description: Use for the typical or average person in Poland: median age, wage, flat, mortgage, pension, spending and car. Profile of the typical person in Poland (finwire_average_pole) built from the latest official readings: median age (Eurostat), median gross and net wage (GUS), median price per m2 of a flat (GUS), average new mortgage (BIK), model monthly mortgage payment, average ZUS pension, spending per person (GUS household budgets), car age classes (Eurostat) and the most registered car brand. Each trait carries its measure (median, mean, model, distribution, most frequent) and its own data period.
name: get_average_pole
title: Average Pole (typical person in Poland)
